versions.changelog: Rebuilt every building on the national registry's laser-scanned heights, replacing the modeled and flat placeholder heights the maps shipped with — buildings and their tunnel-clearance foundations now stand at surveyed height.

Added the first Slovak maps — Bratislava, Košice - Prešov, Žilina, Trenčín, Nitra, Banská Bystrica, and Poprad - Spišská Nová Ves — with residents, workers, and demand for airports, universities, hospitals, museums, and libraries.
